subject: Ardent Fintech - sudden p99/throughput regression after modelpack v5.1 + qprofile
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@ardentfintech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@ardentfintech.com>, platform@ardentfintech.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency & strange outputs after today's modelpack + quant swap (urgent)

Hi Jonas,

We've been seeing a big jump in p99 latency and a handful of incorrect/misaligned responses starting around 08:50 PDT after your backend rolled modelpack v5.1 with the new "qv3-int8" quant profile onto our production fleet. The failure modes:

- p95 unchanged (~120ms) but p99 jumped from ~320ms to ~1.6s on our /generate route.
- Throughput dropped ~18% under baseline traffic (same query mix).
- A small set of downstream reconciliation checks flagged hallucinations on structured fields (examples attached).

We pulled a few traces and attached one event log + one misresponse example. This is impacting our billing-cycle reconciliation jobs and we've already opened an internal incident at our ops side.

Can your team please triage urgently? We need a 30m bridge in the next hour if possible — our CTO is being briefed.

Attachments: trace-20260518-0911.log (text), sample-misresponse-1.txt (text)

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Director, Platform Engineering
Ardent Fintech
phone: +1 415-555-0189

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Priya Shah <priya@ardentfintech.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency & strange outputs after today's modelpack + quant swap (urgent)

Priya — thanks for the quick flag and attachments. Sorry for the disruption. We're pulling a small on-call bridge now and will join ASAP.

Immediate plan:
- 09:45 PDT bridge (joining link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=ardent-call)
- Neha (applied ML) will lead an initial triage to determine whether the delta is in the quant execution path or kernel selection.
- If we confirm a production-quality regression, we'll propose a temporary rollback to the previous modelpack and qprofile, and open a write-up for credits / SLA remediation.

Can you confirm the top business workflows affected (e.g., reconciliation job names, percentage of traffic hitting /generate vs /chat) so we can prioritize traces?

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Priya Shah <priya@ardentfintech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency & strange outputs after today's modelpack + quant swap (urgent)

Adding quick findings from first 30m of triage:

- Reproduced p99 spike locally with Ardent's traffic profile by forcing qv3-int8 kernel path. p50/p95 same; p99 tail grows non-linearly with certain long-context sessions.
- Attached trace shows repeated KV cache misses on warm-hot sessions; allocator falls back to slower memcpy path leading to token latency amplification.
- In addition, a small number of sequences show attention normalization differences under INT8 that change topical tokens in structured outputs — this isn't full hallucination but causes downstream reconciliation to fail.
- CPU-side batching util dropped ~12% due to backpressure from slower token generation; that explains throughput drop.

Immediate mitigations we can apply (short window):
1) Flip routing for Ardent to v5.1 but with qprofile qv2 (the older int8 path we've validated) — low-risk and quick to change.
2) If you need instant relief, rollback modelpack to v5.0 (we have ready image) — requires ~7 min cutover and warm-up.

I'll capture a short repro and an ops-level runbook on JIRA-SUP-3234 during the bridge.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Priya Shah <priya@ardentfintech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency & strange outputs after today's modelpack + quant swap (urgent)

Team — heads up that Ardent's CTO is in the loop. If Neha's mitigations are effective, we should prepare a short exec brief for Ardent and our leadership (outline: what happened, root cause, mitigation, next steps, customer impact, proposed credits).

Marissa, can you coordinate a remediation package and initial credit proposal? We should propose a rollback + 10% service credit for the affected time window if throughput/quality are materially impaired.

Priya — we'll prioritize the rollback if you prefer speed over a qprofile flip. Let us know which you want.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Success & Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya@ardentfintech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@ardentfintech.com>, platform@ardentfintech.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency & strange outputs after today's modelpack + quant swap (urgent)

Thanks all. We took the qprofile flip to qv2 at 10:12 PDT per Neha's suggestion and saw p99 return to baseline over ~20 minutes, and throughput normalized. We pushed a hotfix to reconciliation to make the matcher more tolerant while you work on a permanent fix.

Business impact: two reconciliation windows missed their SLA (estimated revenue impact ~ $36k for the cycle); our CTO requested a formal incident report and a credit discussion.

Next steps we'd like from Redwood:
- A brief incident timeline and root-cause note for our security/compliance team.
- Proposed remediation timeline for qv3-int8 path stability and exact kernel changes required.
- Draft credit proposal we can review with our procurement/legal.

We'll join a debrief tomorrow 09:00 PDT if that works for your team.

Attachments: none in this follow-up.

Priya Shah
Director, Platform Engineering
Ardent Fintech
